title.narrative: Number of NGOs attending to Basin Management Committees

description.narrative: Number of NGOs attending to Basin Management Committees

comment.narrative: Due to late foundation of the network because of the covid pandemia the number of the NGOs who were participated to committees lower than the target value. The members have been encouraged and guided to apply to committees meetings and the number is expected to be increased by the end of 2022.At the project design phase an ambitously high final target for this indicator has been identified. However during project implemantation it was seen that due to several reasons this target will not be met. These reasons can be summarized as cancellation andor postponement of committee meetings due to covid pandemia the long application and acceptance durations for NGOs in some cases up to one year due to official procedures lack of NGOs in some provinces or NGO existence with capacities not adequate to attend.Under the current situation a revision is requested for this indicator.

title.narrative: Number of NGOs attending to Local Wetland Commissions

description.narrative: Number of NGOs attending to Local Wetland Commissions

comment.narrative: Due to late foundation of the network because of the covid pandemia the number of the NGOs who were participated to commissions is lower than the target value. The members have been encouraged and guided to apply to commisions meetings and the number is expected to be increased by the end of 2022.At the project design phase an ambitously high final target for this indicator has been identified. However during project implemantation it was seen that due to several reasons this target will not be met. These reasons can be summarized as cancellation andor postponement of commision meetings due to covid pandemia the long application and acceptance durations for NGOs in some cases up to one year due to official procedures lack of NGOs in some provinces or NGO existence with capacities not adequate to attend. Under the current situation a revision is requested for this indicator.
